annotations.title: Mark an attack surface item handled or public

description: Decide on an Attack surface "Needs you" item, as its "It's handled" and "Meant to be public" buttons do. handled starts a targeted re-check of that one signal (no credits; Odin limits how many items it checks again each hour, and checks a service only on an address that is watched daily); the item stays until the check no longer sees it. public keeps it out of Needs you until a material change, and returns sibling hosts Odin suggests the same for, as suggestions only. A new decision replaces the item's open one. Requires write permission and acts as the API key creator, who must be a member or above. Only call it when the user explicitly asks.

fromSuggestion.description: True when confirming a sibling host Odin suggested after an earlier public decision.

kind.description: handled: the issue is fixed, so Odin checks it again straight away and closes it only if the check no longer sees it. public: the host is meant to be reachable, so the item leaves Needs you until Odin sees a material change on the host.

reason.description: Why, in the person's words. Recorded with the decision.

signal.description: The item's id from list_attack_surface_needs, or a suggestion's signal.
